title: [Security] Static frontend authentication is entirely client-side and forgeable
[Security] Passwords hashed with unsalted SHA-256 in localStorage; data survives logout
[Security] No rate limiting on login or public forms; remember-me is on by default
[Security] Resume ownership check is skipped when user_id is null (IDOR)
[Security] PUT /resumes/{id} accepts unvalidated JSON, colour and photo URLs
[Security] Accent colour interpolated unescaped into editor HTML attributes (stored XSS)
[Security] CSS injection via unvalidated colour in Blade inline styles and the CV renderer
[Security] Blog body rendered with {!! !!} and no sanitisation (stored XSS)
[Security] Image uploads accept SVG and are served publicly without access control
[Security] OAuth accounts linked by email without proof of ownership; tokens stored in plaintext
[Security] Weak password policy (minimum 6 characters, no breach check)
[Security] Unsafe production defaults in .env.example (debug on, unencrypted non-secure sessions)
[Security] Seeder creates a known demo account with a hardcoded password
[Security] No CSP, SRI or security headers; third-party script and font loaded unchecked
[Security] GET /resumes/create mutates state; guest editor is unauthenticated and unthrottled
[Security] Account deletion leaves resumes, photos and OAuth tokens behind
